title: CompTox ModelCard
description: Machine-readable CompTox model card aligned with OECD QSAR validation principles and MCP requirements.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the CompTox model card schema used to validate this document.

modelDetails.description: Core identity and lifecycle information for the model.

name.description: Canonical model name (e.g., TEST Consensus Acute Toxicity).

version.description: Model semantic version or tagged release identifier.

modelType.description: High-level classification for the model (e.g., QSAR, Read-Across, PBPK, Analogue-Search).

description.description: Short overview of the model purpose and capabilities.

organizations.description: Affiliated organizations sponsoring or maintaining the model.

releaseDate.description: Date when this model version was released to production.

lastUpdated.description: Date of the latest material update to this model card or implementation.

license.description: License governing model distribution or use.

tags.description: Keywords describing the domain, endpoints, or regulatory programs.

documentation.description: Links to human-readable technical documentation, publications, or SOPs.

intendedUse.description: Specific use cases, audiences, and limitations for the model.

summary.description: Narrative summary of intended purpose and regulatory context.

inScope.description: Explicitly supported use cases, decision contexts, or chemical classes.

outOfScope.description: Use cases, populations, or chemicals for which the model should not be applied.

limitations.description: Known scientific or technical limitations relevant to agents or reviewers.

warnings.description: Cautionary statements that must be surfaced alongside predictions.

regulatoryPrograms.description: Regulatory programs or guidance documents under which this model is accepted.

oecdValidationPrinciples.description: Compliance details for the OECD five principles of QSAR validation.

description.description: Precise description of the biological or physicochemical endpoint predicted by the model.

unit.description: Measurement unit associated with the endpoint, if applicable.

speciesOrSystem.description: Species, biological system, or experimental context used to measure the endpoint.

summary.description: Concise description of the algorithm, statistical method, or machine learning architecture.

methodClass.description: High-level classification (e.g., linear regression, random forest, k-NN, read-across).

implementation.description: Primary implementation reference (e.g., software package, repository URL).

references.description: Peer-reviewed publications or technical reports detailing the algorithm.

definedApplicabilityDomain.description: Summary of AD approach; detailed machine-readable definition is in the top-level applicabilityDomain section.

summary.description: Narrative summary of the applicability domain technique(s).

relatedTools.description: Names of MCP tools that enforce this AD (e.g., test.check_applicability_domain).

goodnessOfFitMetrics.description: Quantitative performance metrics for internal and external validation.

internalValidation.description: Metrics derived from training or cross-validation.

externalValidation.description: Metrics derived from external or hold-out datasets.

applicabilityDomainMetrics.description: Metrics specific to AD performance (coverage, false positive rate, etc.).

summary.description: Explanation of mechanistic plausibility or descriptor relevance.

confidence.description: Assessment of strength of mechanistic evidence (e.g., strong, moderate, speculative).

trainingData.description: Provenance and characteristics of the training dataset.

records.description: Total number of records (rows) used for training.

descriptorCount.description: Number of descriptors/features used by the model.

preprocessing.description: Data curation and preprocessing steps applied prior to model training.

classBalance.description: Summary of class balance or distribution characteristics, if applicable.

evaluationData.description: Details for external validation datasets and methodologies.

validationApproach.description: Description of the validation methodology (e.g., k-fold CV, external test set).

metrics.description: Quantitative performance metrics derived from evaluation datasets.

applicabilityDomainCoverage.description: Fraction of evaluation dataset predictions that fell within the applicability domain.

applicabilityDomain.description: Machine-readable applicability domain definition used to enforce guardrails.

summary.description: Overall description of the AD methodology and its role in the workflow.

criteria.description: List of criteria that define the applicability domain boundaries.

mcpTools.description: Names of MCP tools responsible for enforcing the AD checks.

policy.description: Policy guidance controlling how out-of-domain results are handled (e.g., block, warn).

errorCodes.description: Expected error codes or statuses emitted when AD checks fail.

confidenceBands.description: Optional mapping of AD confidence to downstream decision guidance.

references.description: Citations describing the AD algorithm or validation.

ethicalConsiderations.description: Bias, fairness, or ethical implications of the model.

risks.description: Known ethical or bias-related risks to surface to users.

mitigations.description: Mitigation strategies or guidance for interpreting model outputs.

humanOversight.description: Description of required human oversight or SME review.

provenance.description: Provenance, version control, and audit metadata.

sourceRepositories.description: Repositories, data stores, or registries containing canonical model assets.

id.description: Build identifier or commit hash used to produce the deployable artifact.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the build was produced.

environment.description: Description of build environment (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow, container digest).

value.description: Checksum value for the model artifact or dataset bundle.

versionHistory.description: Chronological record of major updates to the model or card.

approvedBy.description: Stakeholders who have reviewed/approved the model card.

notes.description: Free-form notes or additional context not captured elsewhere.
Context or relevance of the reference.

dataset.description: Dataset name or split associated with the metric.

description.description: Additional context for the metric calculation.

source.description: Data source or repository from which the dataset was obtained.

description.description: Narrative description of the dataset contents.

accessUrl.description: URL where the dataset can be accessed or requested.

recordCount.description: Number of records in the dataset.

parameters.description: Machine-readable parameters defining the criterion (thresholds, descriptor names, etc.).

label.description: Human-readable label for the confidence band (e.g., High, Moderate, Low).

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0-1) included in the band.

actions.description: Recommended actions or policy guidance when a prediction falls in this band.
